entity_inventory_basis.finding: THE THREE FLIGHT RECEIPTS DO NOT SHARE ONE BASIS. Arm A (the 2026-09-06 usage-cells verdict) and cell 1 reproduce to the digit on dev10; cells 2 and 3 reproduce to the digit on subset1500 and on nothing else. This was found by reproducing each receipt, not chosen: each triple reproduces on exactly one basis. The identity gate therefore checks every arm against the basis its own receipt used -- which is what proves this read is over the same sealed tables -- and every contrast is then computed on the comparator's basis for all four arms, because a paired contrast whose arms use different inventories is not a paired contrast
entity_inventory_basis.what_it_changes: the per-call entity inventory feeds classify_span, so it moves the agentic error rate and, through the runaway-head rule, the boundary block. Corpus WER comes from the scorer and is identical on both bases
